articles.author: Greenland Mines Ltd
articles.headline: Greenland Mines More Than Doubles Control Position in the Sarfartoq Rare Earth Magnet District in West Greenland
sourceWarnings: El titular puede sugerir una ampliación ya obtenida, pero el cuerpo describe una solicitud de licencia pendiente de aprobación. No se registra como licencia concedida ni como reservas demostradas.
articles.summary: Despite its headline about an expanded control position, the release says Greenland Mines submitted an application for approximately 262 square kilometres of additional exploration area. Government approval remains pending; the area has no estimated mineral resource, and mineral resources elsewhere are not mineral reserves or demonstrated economic viability.
